```{r}
#****************************************************************************
# 1. HELPER FUNCTIONS
#****************************************************************************

#Date cleaning (carried over from ReMAPP — handles Excel serials, bad years)

clean_date <- function(x, min_year = 2019) {
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(as.Date(x, origin = "1899-12-30"))
  x_chr <- stringr::str_trim(as.character(x))
  x_chr[x_chr == ""] <- NA_character_
  x_chr <- stringr::str_replace(x_chr,
                                "^7(0[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2})$", "2//1")
  parsed <- suppressWarnings(lubridate::parse_date_time(
    x_chr,
    orders = c("Ymd","Y-m-d","Y.m.d","mdY","m/d/Y","m.d.Y",
               "dmY","d/m/Y","d.m.Y","Ymd HMS","mdy HMS","dmy HMS"),
    exact = FALSE, tz = "UTC"
  ))
  need_num <- is.na(parsed) & !is.na(x_chr) &
    stringr::str_detect(x_chr, "^[0-9]{5}$")
  if (any(need_num, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    parsed[need_num] <- as.POSIXct(
      as.Date(as.numeric(x_chr[need_num]), origin = "1899-12-30"), tz = "UTC")
  }
  d <- as.Date(parsed)
  d[!is.na(d) & lubridate::year(d) < min_year] <- as.Date(NA)
  return(d)
}

#First non-missing value helper
first_non_na <- function(x) {
  i <- which(!is.na(x))[1]
  if (is.na(i)) NA_real_ else x[i]
}
```

```{r}
#****************************************************************************
# 3. FERRITIN UNIT CORRECTION
#****************************************************************************

total_cohort <- total_cohort %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(
    p50_ferritin = median(m08_ferritin_lborres, na.rm = TRUE),
    ferritin_lborres = case_when(
      site == "Kenya" & p50_ferritin < 15 ~ m08_ferritin_lborres * 10,
      site != "Kenya" & p50_ferritin < 10 ~ m08_ferritin_lborres * 10,
      TRUE ~ m08_ferritin_lborres
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

#check
total_cohort %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(
    original_median = median(m08_ferritin_lborres, na.rm = TRUE),
    corrected_median = median(ferritin_lborres, na.rm = TRUE),
    changed_n = sum(m08_ferritin_lborres != ferritin_lborres, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
criteria <- c(

labels <- c(
  "BMI 18.5–30 & MUAC >23 cm",
  "Singleton pregnancy",
  "No smoking/tobacco/betel nut",
  "No alcohol",
  "No chronic disease",
  "HIV negative",
  "Blood pressure <140/90",
  "No malaria",
  "HBV negative",
  "HCV negative",
  "No infection history",
  "No gestational diabetes"
)

remaining <- prep_criteria

flow_table <- tibble(
  Step = "Starting cohort",
  Criterion = "Participants with biomarker data",
  Excluded = NA_integer_,
  Remaining = nrow(remaining)
)

for(i in seq_along(criteria)){

  before <- nrow(remaining)

  remaining <- remaining %>%
    filter(.data[[criteria[i]]] == 1 |
             (criteria[i] == "crit_drink" & .data[[criteria[i]]] == 666))

  after <- nrow(remaining)

  flow_table <- bind_rows(
    flow_table,
    tibble(
      Step = paste0(i),
      Criterion = labels[i],
      Excluded = before - after,
      Remaining = after
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
#****************************************************************************
# 4. DEFINE HEALTHY COHORT  critERIA + TOTAL COHORT DF
#****************************************************************************

prep_criteria <- total_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    # 1. BMI 18.5–30 AND MUAC >23
     crit_bmi_muac = case_when(
      bmi_enroll >= 18.5 & bmi_enroll <= 30 & muac_enroll > 23 ~ 1,
      bmi_enroll < 18.5 | bmi_enroll > 30 | muac_enroll <= 23 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ 55
    ),

    # 2. Singleton pregnancy
     crit_singlepreg = case_when(
      singleton == 1 ~ 1,
      singleton == 0 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ 55
    ),

    # 3. No smoking / tobacco / betelnut
     crit_smoke = case_when(
      smoke == 0 & chew_tobacco == 0 & chew_betelnut == 0 ~ 1,
      smoke == 1 | chew_tobacco == 1 | chew_betelnut == 1 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ 55
    ),

    # 4. No alcohol
     crit_drink = case_when(
      site == "Pakistan" ~ 666,
      drink == 0 ~ 1,
      drink == 1 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ 55
    ),

    # 5. No infection history
     crit_infection = case_when(
      m09_fever_ceoccur == 0 &
      m09_infect_mhoccur_1 == 0 &
      m09_infect_mhoccur_2 == 0 &
      m09_infect_mhoccur_3 == 0 &
      m09_infect_mhoccur_4 == 0 &
      m09_infect_mhoccur_5 == 0 &
      m09_infect_mhoccur_6 == 0 &
      m09_infect_mhoccur_7 == 0 &
      m09_infect_mhoccur_8 == 0 &
      m09_infect_mhoccur_9 == 0 &
      m09_infect_mhoccur_10 == 0 ~ 1,

      m09_fever_ceoccur == 1 |
      m09_infect_mhoccur_1 == 1 |
      m09_infect_mhoccur_2 == 1 |
      m09_infect_mhoccur_3 == 1 |
      m09_infect_mhoccur_4 == 1 |
      m09_infect_mhoccur_5 == 1 |
      m09_infect_mhoccur_6 == 1 |
      m09_infect_mhoccur_7 == 1 |
      m09_infect_mhoccur_8 == 1 |
      m09_infect_mhoccur_9 == 1 |
      m09_infect_mhoccur_10 == 1 ~ 0,

      TRUE ~ 55
    ),

    # 6. No chronic disease
     crit_chronic = case_when(
      m04_cancer_ever_mhoccur == 0 &
      m04_cardiac_ever_mhoccur == 0 &
      m04_kidney_ever_mhoccur == 0 ~ 1,

      m04_cancer_ever_mhoccur == 1 |
      m04_cardiac_ever_mhoccur == 1 |
      m04_kidney_ever_mhoccur == 1 ~ 0,
      
      m04_cancer_ever_mhoccur == 99 | #Unknown history ineligible
      m04_cardiac_ever_mhoccur == 99 |
      m04_kidney_ever_mhoccur == 99 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ 55
    ),

    # 7. No GDM
     crit_gdm = case_when(
      diab_gest_any == 0 ~ 1,
      diab_gest_any == 1 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ 55
    ),

    # 8. No HIV
     crit_hiv = case_when(
      hiv_positive_ever_preg == 0 ~ 1,
      hiv_positive_ever_preg == 1 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ 55
    ),

    # 9. No malaria
     crit_malaria = case_when(
      mal_rdt_positive_enroll == 0 | site %in% c("India-CMC", "India-SAS", "Pakistan") ~ 1,
      mal_rdt_positive_enroll == 1 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ 55
    ),

    # 10. No Hepatitis B
     crit_hepatitisb = case_when(
      hbv_positive_ever_preg == 0 ~ 1,
      hbv_positive_ever_preg == 1 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ 55
    ),

    # 11. No Hepatitis C
     crit_hepatitisc = case_when(
      hcv_positive_ever_preg == 0 ~ 1,
      hcv_positive_ever_preg == 1 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ 55
    )
  )

#variables created from raw data ----------------

 #12.Blood pressure: SBP <140, DBP <9
prep_criteria <- prep_criteria %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    m06_bp_sys_avg = mean(
      c(m06_bp_sys_vsorres_1,
        m06_bp_sys_vsorres_2,
        m06_bp_sys_vsorres_3),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    m06_bp_dia_avg = mean(
      c(m06_bp_dia_vsorres_1,
        m06_bp_dia_vsorres_2,
        m06_bp_dia_vsorres_3),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

     crit_bp = case_when(
      m06_bp_sys_avg > 0 &
        m06_bp_sys_avg < 140 &
        m06_bp_dia_avg > 0 &
        m06_bp_dia_avg < 90 ~ 1,

      m06_bp_sys_avg >= 140 |
        m06_bp_dia_avg >= 90 ~ 0,

      TRUE ~ 55
    )
  )

missing_codes <- c(-5, -6, -7, -9)

prep_criteria <- prep_criteria %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        m06_bp_sys_vsorres_1,
        m06_bp_sys_vsorres_2,
        m06_bp_sys_vsorres_3,
        m06_bp_dia_vsorres_1,
        m06_bp_dia_vsorres_2,
        m06_bp_dia_vsorres_3
      ),
      ~ if_else(.x %in% missing_codes, NA_real_, as.numeric(.x))
    )
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    m06_bp_sys_avg = mean(
      c(m06_bp_sys_vsorres_1, m06_bp_sys_vsorres_2, m06_bp_sys_vsorres_3),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    m06_bp_dia_avg = mean(
      c(m06_bp_dia_vsorres_1, m06_bp_dia_vsorres_2, m06_bp_dia_vsorres_3),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    m06_bp_sys_avg = if_else(is.nan(m06_bp_sys_avg), NA_real_, m06_bp_sys_avg),
    m06_bp_dia_avg = if_else(is.nan(m06_bp_dia_avg), NA_real_, m06_bp_dia_avg),

    crit_bp = case_when(
      m06_bp_sys_avg > 0 & m06_bp_sys_avg < 140 &
        m06_bp_dia_avg > 0 & m06_bp_dia_avg < 90 ~ 1,

      m06_bp_sys_avg >= 140 |
        m06_bp_dia_avg >= 90 ~ 0,

      TRUE ~ 55
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


save(prep_criteria, file = "Z:/Isa_working_files/prep_criteria_5_31.rda")

crit55_by_site <- prep_criteria %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("crit_"),
    names_to = "crit",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  filter(value == 55) %>%
  count(site, crit, name = "n_55") %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(pct_55_within_site = 100 * n_55 / sum(n_55)) %>%
  arrange(site, desc(n_55)) %>%
  ungroup()


```

```{r}
#****************************************************************************
#5. CREATE HEALTHY COHORT DF
#****************************************************************************

eligibility_outcomes <- prep_criteria %>% 
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    healthy_check = sum(
      across(starts_with("crit_")) %in% c(1, 0, 666), 
                        na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  
    healthy_eligible = case_when(
       crit_bmi_muac == 1 &
       crit_singlepreg == 1 &
       crit_smoke == 1 &
       crit_drink %in% c(1, 666) &
       crit_chronic == 1 &
       crit_hiv == 1 &
       crit_bp == 1 &
       crit_malaria == 1 &
       crit_hepatitisb == 1 &
       crit_hepatitisc == 1 &
       crit_infection == 1 &
       crit_gdm == 1 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
  
df_healthy <- eligibility_outcomes %>% 
  filter(healthy_eligible == 1)

df_non_healthy <- eligibility_outcomes %>% 
  filter(healthy_eligible == 0)

cat("\n--- HEALTHY COHORT COUNTS ---\n")
cat("All 12 criteria applied:         ");
print(sum(eligibility_outcomes$healthy_eligible == 1))
print(table(eligibility_outcomes$site[eligibility_outcomes$healthy_eligible == 1]))


print(table(eligibility_outcomes$site[eligibility_outcomes$healthy_eligible == 0]))


eligibility_outcomes <- eligibility_outcomes %>%
  mutate(healthy_flag = healthy_eligible)

#NON-HEALTHY COHORT 
no_eligibility_outcomes <- eligibility_outcomes %>%
  mutate(healthy_flag = healthy_eligible) %>%
   filter(healthy_flag == 0)
```

```{r}
df_biomarkers_long <- eligibility_outcomes %>%
  select(site, momid, pregid, preg_start_date , healthy_eligible, healthy_check, healthy_eligible) %>%
  left_join(df_biomarkers, by = c("site","momid", "pregid")) %>%
  mutate(
    preg_start_date = lubridate::ymd(preg_start_date)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    visit_date = lubridate::ymd(m08_lbstdat),
    ga_wks  = as.numeric(visit_date - preg_start_date) / 7,
    ga_days = as.numeric(visit_date - preg_start_date),
    trimester = case_when(
      ga_wks > 0 & ga_wks < 14 ~ 1,
      ga_wks >= 14 & ga_wks < 28 ~ 2,
      ga_wks >= 28 & ga_wks <= 45 ~ 3,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    #cbc derived ratios
    nlr = m08_cbc_neu_fcc_lborres / m08_cbc_lymph_fcc_lborres,
    lmr = m08_cbc_lymph_fcc_lborres / m08_cbc_mono_fcc_lborres,
    plr = m08_cbc_plate_lborres   / m08_cbc_lymph_fcc_lborres,
    sii = (m08_cbc_neu_fcc_lborres * m08_cbc_plate_lborres) /  
           m08_cbc_lymph_fcc_lborres) %>%
  rename(
    crp = m08_crp_lborres,
    wbc = m08_cbc_wbc_lborres,
    plt = m08_cbc_plate_lborres,
    agp = m08_agp_lborres
  )


#biomarker wide data set
df_bio_wide_all <- df_biomarkers_long %>%
  group_by(site, momid, pregid) %>%
  summarise(
    preg_start_date = first(preg_start_date),
    healthy_eligible = first(healthy_eligible),
    healthy_check = first(healthy_check),

    bio_n = sum(!is.na(crp) | !is.na(wbc) | !is.na(plt) | !is.na(agp)),

    bio_list = {
      x <- tibble(
        visit_date, ga_wks,
        crp, wbc, plt, agp, nlr, lmr, plr, sii
      ) %>%
        filter(!is.na(crp) | !is.na(wbc) | !is.na(plt) | !is.na(agp)) %>%
        arrange(visit_date)

      if (nrow(x) == 0) "No biomarkers" else
        paste0(
          format(x$visit_date, "%Y-%m-%d"),
          " (", sprintf("%.1f", x$ga_wks), "w): ",
          "CRP=", sprintf("%.2f", x$crp), ", ",
          "WBC=", sprintf("%.2f", x$wbc), ", ",
          "PLT=", sprintf("%.0f", x$plt), ", ",
          "AGP=", sprintf("%.2f", x$agp), ", ",
          "NLR=", sprintf("%.2f", x$nlr), ", ",
          "LMR=", sprintf("%.2f", x$lmr), ", ",
          "PLR=", sprintf("%.2f", x$plr), ", ",
          "SII=", sprintf("%.0f", x$sii),
          collapse = "; "
        )
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )


df_bio_long_hc   <- df_biomarkers_long  %>% filter(healthy_eligible == 1)
df_bio_wide_hc   <- df_bio_wide_all  %>% filter(healthy_eligible == 1)

#NON HEALTHY BIOMARKER DF
df_bio_long_nh   <- df_biomarkers_long  %>% filter(healthy_eligible == 0)

#remove outliers
df_biomarkers_long <- df_biomarkers_long %>%
  filter(is.na(ga_wks) | between(ga_wks, 5, 41)) %>%
  filter(is.na(crp) | between(crp, 0, 200)) %>%
  filter(is.na(agp) | between(agp, 0, 3)) %>%
  filter(is.na(wbc) | between(wbc, 1, 50)) %>%
  filter(is.na(plt) | between(plt, 20, 1000))

df_bio_wide_all <- df_biomarkers_long %>%
  group_by(site, momid, pregid) %>%
  summarise(
    preg_start_date       = first(preg_start_date),
    healthy_eligible      = first(healthy_eligible),
    healthy_check         = first(healthy_check),

    # number of biomarker measurements
    bio_n = sum(
      !is.na(crp) | !is.na(wbc) | !is.na(plt) | !is.na(agp)
    ),

    # readable list of all biomarker values
    bio_list = {
      x <- tibble(
        visit_date = visit_date,
        ga_wks     = ga_wks,
        crp, wbc, plt, agp,
        nlr, lmr, plr, sii
      ) %>%
        filter(
          !is.na(crp) | !is.na(wbc) | !is.na(plt) | !is.na(agp)
        ) %>%
        arrange(visit_date)

      if (nrow(x) == 0) {
        "No biomarkers"
      } else {
        paste0(
          format(x$visit_date, "%Y-%m-%d"),
          " (", sprintf("%.1f", x$ga_wks), "w): ",
          "CRP=", sprintf("%.2f", x$crp), ", ",
          "WBC=", sprintf("%.2f", x$wbc), ", ",
          "PLT=", sprintf("%.0f", x$plt), ", ",
          "AGP=", sprintf("%.2f", x$agp), ", ",
          "NLR=", sprintf("%.2f", x$nlr), ", ",
          "LMR=", sprintf("%.2f", x$lmr), ", ",
          "PLR=", sprintf("%.2f", x$plr), ", ",
          "SII=", sprintf("%.0f", x$sii),
          collapse = "; "
        )
      }
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

df_bio_wide_hc   <- df_bio_wide_all  %>% filter(healthy_eligible == 1)
```

```{r}
    C7 = ifelse(!is.na( crit_bp), crit_bp,55),

    C9 = ifelse(!is.na( crit_hepatitisb), crit_hepatitisb,55),
    C10 = ifelse(!is.na( crit_hepatitisc), crit_hepatitisc,55),
    C11 = ifelse(!is.na( crit_infection), crit_infection,55),
    C12 = ifelse(!is.na( crit_gdm), crit_gdm,55),
  ) %>% 
  mutate(across(matches("C\\d+"),
```

```{r}
### below is code for a by site exclusion check
ghana <- prep_criteria %>% filter(site == "Ghana")

 criteria <- c(
  "crit_age","crit_ga","crit_bmi_muac","crit_height",
  "crit_singlepreg","crit_lbw","crit_stillbirth",
  "crit_unpl_cesarian","crit_smoke","crit_drink",
  "crit_infection","crit_chronic","crit_gdm",
  "crit_hiv","crit_malaria","crit_hepatitisb",
  "crit_hepatitisc","crit_bp", "crit_iron"
)

remaining <- ghana

for (c in  criteria) {
  before <- nrow(remaining)
  remaining <- remaining %>% filter(.data[[c]] == 1)
  after <- nrow(remaining)

  cat(c, ": removed", before - after,
      "remaining", after, "\n")
}

fmt_np <- function(x) {
  n <- sum(x == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  d <- sum(!is.na(x))
  pct <- ifelse(d == 0, NA_real_, n / d * 100)
  paste0(n, " (", round(pct, 1), ")")
}

make_total_table <- function(data, label) {
  tibble(
    Measure = c(
      "Participants assessed for eligibility, N",
      "Eligible for healthy cohort (all criteria applied), n (%)",
      "Eligible for healthy cohort (GA criterion not applied), n (%)"
    ),
    Definition = label,
    Value = c(
      as.character(nrow(data)),
      fmt_np(data$healthy_eligible),
      fmt_np(data$healthy_eligible_ga)
    )
  )
}

  make_total_table(eligibility_outcomes, "Without iron criterion"),
  make_total_table(eligibility_outcomes_ironinc, "With iron criterion")
) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Definition,
    values_from = Value
  )

iron_compare


make_site_table <- function(data, label) {

  site_summary <- data %>%
    group_by(site) %>%
    summarise(
      `Participants assessed for eligibility, N` = as.character(n()),
      `Eligible for healthy cohort (all criteria applied), n (%)` =
        fmt_np(healthy_eligible),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  total_summary <- data %>%
    summarise(
      site = "Total",
      `Participants assessed for eligibility, N` = as.character(n()),
      `Eligible for healthy cohort (all criteria applied), n (%)` =
        fmt_np(healthy_eligible),
      `Eligible for healthy cohort (GA criterion not applied), n (%)` =
        fmt_np(healthy_eligible_ga)
    )

  bind_rows(site_summary, total_summary) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      -site,
      names_to = "Measure",
      values_to = "Value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Definition = label)
}
```
